@bibbymoynihan.bsky.social
I think you’re a hunk-a hunk-a burning shit.

Can we slow down a bit?

McDonald’s all-day breakfast lasted from 2015-2020. 2020 was also when Walmart stopped being 24 hours. 

Sierra Mist was discontinued in 2023. 

I know a lot changed with Covid but it was 6 years ago, not 50.

Pizza Hut buffets do seem ancient but those might be coming back!
This is the joke that was quite popular online and which Vulture/Splitsider called “inexcusable.” www.vulture.com/2012/03/snl-...

With the passing of Mr. Norris, I’m going to honor great American tradition by making it all about myself and sharing this image of the most successful of the five total jokes I wrote that got onto Weekend Update when I was a freelance joke submitter.

Chuck Norris didn’t die, he just finally defeated life. 

people.com/chuck-norris...
How did we all suddenly become okay with calling sauced food “wet”?
It’s kind of weird that the day after the Irish drinking holiday isn’t the one called Boxing Day.

It was only a few years ago that I learned that some people are very insistent that you spell it “St. Paddy’s Day” and not “St. Patty’s Day” and I was so excited to have something new to be pedantic about.

Somehow, it was decided that 5th graders at my kid’s school should wear their class t-shirts today which are GRAY. 

Admittedly, my town is more Italian Catholic than Irish Catholic, but, like, every other little league coach is named Michael Somethingirish. So I can’t be the only one grumbling.
￼Finally threw out my Christmas tree!
